grading.check_scoring: Each check passes only when every required fact is substantively correct with source references that support it. Allow equivalent wording and nearby line spans/symbol references. Do not require facts not requested in the prompt.
grading.task_success: All checks pass. Report passed_checks and total_checks as well as pass/fail; no tool-use, token, speed or treatment-based credit.
grading.false_positives: List fabricated affected callers or claims that unchanged APIs must migrate. Fail the corresponding affected-callers/nonconsumers/bounded-evidence check. Unsupported whole-repository certainty fails bounded-evidence (impact) or the relevant route/measurement check (trace).
grading.numeric_errors: Wrong scenario counters, retry count or conflict totals fail the affected check; do not repair the answer from unrelated facts.
grading.blinding: Grade answer and source evidence without treatment, tool transcript, latency or token usage.
